annotations.title: Price a shopping list or receipt

description:
Price a whole shopping list, or every line of a grocery receipt (up to 100
    lines in one call), at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores and Lidl: each item
    matched to the same product at every store, the cheapest store for each
    item, each store's basket total, and a cheaper product of the same kind
    (often own-label) where one exists.

    Each line takes name (plain words with brand and size, e.g. "avonmore fresh
    milk 2l"; receipt abbreviations such as "AVNMR FRSH MLK 2L" match poorly)
    and optionally sku (the retailer's item number as printed on its receipts;
    the name is used when the number is not found), barcode, store, quantity,
    and paid (the line total, which gives the saving against what was paid).
    Irish product names say "low fat milk" for what the UK calls "semi
    skimmed". Bags, deposits, discounts and totals are not products.

    Returns, per line, the match and matched_by (sku, barcode or name), the
    cheapest store and price, a cheaper alternative with its pack size and, for
    a receipt, price_at_store_bought; then each store's total with its
    items_missing, cheapest_complete_store, mix_and_match_total and not_found.
    Prices are each retailer's online shelf price from the overnight
    collection; in-store prices can differ. Member prices (Tesco Clubcard,
    Lidl Plus) are reported separately. Each matched item costs one credit;
    items not found are free.

    Args:
        items: e.g. [{"sku": "100685955", "name": "dunnes baked beans",
            "quantity": 2, "paid": 1.30}, {"name": "brennans wholemeal bread"}].
        store: the receipt's supermarket (aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or
            lidl), used for any line that does not name its own.
